component.name: vork
component.summary: This device, its libraries and how they're kept

description.p: The vork node at a glance, in the tray and in a window: Reticulum, the daemon, settings, storage, libraries and their members, and Find. vork itself comes from the vork .deb, and Reticulum (Prns, or another shared instance) is installed apart. A prototype.
